title: Configuring Security Exceptions for the Advanced Threat Protection Policy

blocks.text: To configure security exceptions for the Advanced Threat Protection policy:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Cyberthreat Protection > Policy > Advanced Threat Protection.

In Do Not Scan Content from these URLs, enter the URLs you want to allowlist for ATP, or URLs you don't want to inspect for ATP, and click Add. You can enter up to 1,024 URLs by pressing Enter after each entry. To learn more, see Ranges & Limitations.

For guidance on entering URLs, see the URL format guidelines. For item lists, you can view up to 500 items on a page; filter the list by searching for a word, phrase, or number contained in an item; and remove the first 25K items from the list (Remove 25K Items) or only items from a specific page (Remove Page). If you select Remove 25K Items or Remove Page, a confirmation window appears.

blocks.text: This allowlist also applies to the Malware Protection and Sandbox policies. If you want to allowlist URLs and files completely, you must also configure the URL Filtering, File Type Control, and IPS Control policies. To learn more, see Adding URLs to the Allowlist.

blocks.item: Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: To remove a previously configured security exception:

blocks.item: Go to Cyberthreat Protection > Policy > Advanced Threat Protection.
Click the Delete icon next to the exception you want to remove.
You can remove all configured security exceptions by selecting Remove All.
